task_completion.visual_evidence: Motor configuration tab or 'Select motor' dialog showing 'Estes E9' selected for the motor mount.

task_completion.description: Add a Mass Component of at least 15g inside the Nose Cone.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Component tree showing a 'Mass component' as a child of the 'Nose cone', with the configuration dialog showing a mass of 15g or more.

task_completion.description: Increase the parachute diameter to at least 40.0 cm.

task_completion.description: Save the .ork file and create the text report with required details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing 'upscale_report.txt' containing the motor (E9), mass (15g+), parachute diameter (40cm+), and a max altitude value.

integrity.description: The altitude in the report matches the simulation results in the GUI.
